args.args: ./configure --disable-ogg --disable-asm-optimizations --disable-doxygen-docs --disable-examples --disable-xmms-plugin --disable-cpplibs --disable-shared --enable-static --build=x86_64-pc-linux-gnu (native で config.h を生成し、HAVE_CPUID_H / HAVE_SYS_AUXV_H / FLAC__HAS_X86INTRIN を落として wasm 用に使う)

emcc -O2 -ffp-contract=off -w -I<wasm config.h dir> -I<src>/include -I<src> -I<src>/src/libFLAC/include -DHAVE_CONFIG_H <src>/src/libFLAC/*.c (ia32 / _intrin_ / deduplication / lpc_intrin_neon / ogg_ を除外)
